identity.admin_sid_source: local read-only resolution; user confirmation required before C00/C02

path_policy.unlisted_read: content read and listing denied and recorded; a successful read of a deny root is fatal
layering: trusted_load (dispatcher): exact manifest, dispatcher, dependencies, tool bytes and node.exe; hashed before load
business: exact data inputs + exact process-entry/guard/audit files listed in load_files; no tool directory read
control (p0-audit.cjs): chain tail/append + own segment summary; no business data
product (runner child): copy subtree + own OUT dir; exclusive write list
path_policy.overlap_rule: a path may appear in at most one of read_allow and deny_read for the same layer; the registry is checked mechanically

anchors.what: inline command text of C00-E01 and C03-PROBE-E01
P0_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_SID, P0_CODEX_ACCOUNT, P0_TOOLSRC_MANIFEST_SHA256, RUN_ID, quiet window

anchors.when: before C00; rechecked by C00, C05-PRE, C05-FINAL, C20-SEAL

trust.staged_first_use: C05-FINAL uses the source dispatcher and verifies the staged tree; C06 first executes the staged dispatcher
trust.c00_role: fail-fast gate, not a trust root; H3 is external
trust.load_stability: dispatcher hashes each tool from a handle opened with FileShare.Read (deny write/delete), keeps the handle open until the child is created, and rechecks after exit; the residual verify-to-map window is UNVERIFIED and depends on the C02 ACL
trust.manifest_hash_source: all tool hashes are null and MUST come from the approved RELEASE-MANIFEST.json

audit.chain_writer: p0-audit.cjs control modes, spawned by p0-dispatch.ps1, account WENX\Administrator
audit.line_bytes: every chain record is written as canonical JSON + LF; prev_file_bytes counts the LF

when_bound: C18-BIND-E01 segment_open records c18_state=bound, c18_binding_sha256, c18_destination
the bound order includes the C18 trio; C18-E01 writes only c18_destination
when_unbound: C18-BIND-E01 segment_open records c18_state=disabled-unbound, binding fields null
the unbound order omits the C18 trio; no TEMP or fallback path; phase0 can only end exit-not-met

failure_policy.security_priority: security > fatal > gate > informational; a security-class failure stops the run even if the execution default class is gate

skip_policy.trigger: a gate-class execution fails and has dependents
skip_policy.action: dependents are recorded with segment_skip(reason=dependency-failed) and are never executed
skip_policy.propagation: transitive over deps; a skipped execution cannot satisfy a success gate
skip_policy.report: skipped list is part of C19 index, C20 report and terminal seal

seal_modes.sealed-full: staged_state=complete and every required segment present; full staged recheck performed
seal_modes.degraded-prefix: staged_state=incomplete|absent (early fatal); seal lists the actual prefix and missing items; no full recheck claim
seal_modes.aborted: chain intact and run stopped at a recorded abort point

failure_policy.observer_reclaim: if PROBE fails or exceeds 300 s, the operator terminates it; OBS receives EOF and must close its segment as failed within 900 s; if OBS does not exit, the dispatcher kills it and records observer-reclaimed before any C04
failure_policy.binding_handoff: C18-BIND writes controls/c18-binding.json with CreateNew; its sha256 and destination are also in segment_open; C18 and all later consumers read only the binding file and never re-read P0_SECOND_ARCHIVE
failure_policy.no_pending: every terminal state is written to the chain or the launch record; skipped is a terminal state, not success

fatal: one C07-A for the failed wrapped target if it has not run
C20-SEAL-E01 in aborted or degraded mode
gate: dependent executions are skipped with segment_skip

failure_policy.gate_vs_fatal: security triggers always escalate; C10-C16/C18 product failures are gate unless a security trigger fired
failure_policy.nominal_records: 109/103 count only non-skipped segments; each skip adds one segment_skip record, so reports must use the actual tail
